name: git status
title: Show the working tree status
description: Displays paths that have differences between the index file and the current HEAD commit, paths that have differences between the working tree and the index file, and paths in the working tree that are untracked.

flags.name: -s
flags.description: Give the output in the short format.

flags.name: -b
flags.description: Show the branch and tracking info even in short-format.

examples.explanation: Shows full detailed status of staged, unstaged, and untracked files.
Shows compact short-format output with branch tracking information.

name: git commit
title: Record changes to the repository
description: Create a new commit containing the current contents of the index and the given log message describing the changes.

flags.name: -m
flags.description: Use the given message as the commit message.

flags.name: -a
flags.description: Automatically stage files that have been modified and deleted, but untracked files are not affected.

flags.name: --amend
flags.description: Replace the tip of the current branch by creating a new commit.

examples.command: git commit -m "feat: implement offline search engine"
examples.explanation: Creates a commit with the specified message.

examples.command: git commit -am "fix: handle edge case in parsing"
examples.explanation: Stages all modified tracked files and commits them in a single command.

risk.sideEffects: Creates a new git commit object and advances HEAD.

name: git branch
title: List, create, or delete branches
description: Lists existing branches, creates a new branch, or deletes an existing branch.

flags.name: -a
flags.description: List both remote-tracking branches and local branches.

flags.name: -d
flags.description: Delete a branch. The branch must be fully merged in its upstream branch.

flags.name: -D
flags.description: Shortcut for --delete --force; delete a branch irrespective of its merged status.

examples.explanation: Lists all local branches with the current branch highlighted.
Creates a new branch named 'feature-search' based on the current HEAD.

risk.reversibility: Deleted branches can be recovered via git reflog if unpruned.

name: git reset
title: Reset current HEAD to the specified state
description: Resets the current branch head to commit and optionally updates the index and the working tree.

flags.name: --soft
flags.description: Does not touch the index file or the working tree at all; resets HEAD only.

flags.name: --hard
flags.description: Resets the index and working tree. Any changes to tracked files in the working tree since commit are discarded.

examples.explanation: Undoes the last commit while keeping all modifications staged in the index.
Unstages a specific file while keeping your changes in the working directory.

risk.sideEffects: Rewinds branch history. With --hard, permanently deletes uncommitted changes.
risk.reversibility: Soft resets are reversible via git reflog. Hard resets discard uncommitted work permanently.

name: git diff
title: Show changes between commits, commit and working tree
description: Displays line-by-line modifications between working tree, index, or commits.

flags.name: --staged
flags.description: View changes staged for the next commit.

examples.explanation: Shows unstaged changes in the working directory compared to the index.
Shows changes that are currently staged for commit.

name: git log
title: Show commit logs
description: Shows the commit logs starting from HEAD backwards.

flags.name: -n
flags.description: Limit the number of commits to output.

examples.explanation: Shows the 10 most recent commits in concise one-line format.

name: git stash
title: Stash changes in a dirty working directory
description: Temporarily shelves (or stashes) changes you've made to your working copy so you can work on something else.

flags.name: -u
flags.description: All untracked files are also stashed and then cleaned.

examples.explanation: Saves all local uncommitted changes and resets the working tree to HEAD.
Restores the most recently stashed changes to the working directory.

risk.sideEffects: Modifies working directory and saves changes to git stash stack.
